title: Gaussian bivariate slope
statement:
For real numbers $\rho,a,b$, define the Gaussian bivariate slope to be the standard Gaussian cumulative distribution function evaluated at
\[
\frac{\Phi^{-1}(b)-\rho\,\Phi^{-1}(a)}{\sqrt{1-\rho^2}},
\]
where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian cumulative distribution function and $\Phi^{-1}$ is its quantile function.
